                    verdict="✗ FAIL — point-mass statistic: null has 1 value, p is always 1",
                    detail="Axis-0 failure: the statistic is constant under the null.")
    return dict(pass_=True, gate="G0 NULL VALIDITY",
                verdict=f"✓ PASS — statistic takes {null_support_size} distinct values under null",
                detail=f"null support size = {null_support_size}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G1: design resolution
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate1_design_resolution(n_units, unit_group_order, alpha, sharing="disjoint",
                           randomization="exact", n_shuffles=None):
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)
    
    if randomization == "monte_carlo" and n_shuffles is not None:
        # Monte Carlo: effective N = B+1, not the group order
        N = n_shuffles + 1
        floor = F(1, N)
        note = f"monte carlo (B={n_shuffles}): N = B+1 = {N}, floor = 1/{N}"
        capable = floor <= alpha_f
        opt_capable = capable  # MC has one well-defined floor
        
        verdict = (f"✓ PASS — MC floor = 1/{N} <= alpha = {alpha}"
                   if capable else
                   f"✗ FAIL — MC FLOOR = 1/{N} > alpha = {alpha} (rejection region EMPTY)")
        
        return dict(pass_=capable, gate="G1 DESIGN RESOLUTION",
                    verdict=verdict,
                    detail=f"monte carlo, B = {n_shuffles}, N = B+1 = {N}; {note}",
                    floor_conservative=floor, floor_optimistic=floor,
                    N_outcomes=N,
                    bits_conservative=bits(floor), bits_optimistic=bits(floor),
                    capable_under_all=capable, capable_under_some=opt_capable,
                    randomization=randomization)
    
    # exact randomization
    if sharing == "disjoint":
        floor = F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        cons, opt = floor, floor
        note = "disjoint units: design floor is exact"
    elif sharing == "complete":
        floor = F(1, unit_group_order)
        cons, opt = floor, F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        note = "complete sharing: conservative = 1/|G|, optimistic = 1/|G|^k"
    else:
        cons = F(1, unit_group_order)
        opt = F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        floor = cons
        note = "mixed sharing: bracket between conservative and optimistic"

    N = unit_group_order ** n_units if sharing == "disjoint" else unit_group_order
    capable = floor <= alpha_f
    opt_capable = opt <= alpha_f

    if not opt_capable:
        verdict = "✗ FAIL — DESIGN INCAPABLE: even with full independence, floor > alpha"
    elif capable:
        verdict = "✓ PASS — CAPABLE UNDER EVERY COUPLING: even conservative floor clears alpha"
    else:
        verdict = "· NOTE — UNDECIDED FROM STRUCTURE: depends on randomization (bracket spans alpha)"

    return dict(pass_=capable, gate="G1 DESIGN RESOLUTION",
                verdict=verdict,
                detail=f"design floor (conservative) = {f2s(floor)} "
                       f"({bits(floor):.2f} bits); "
                       f"floor (optimistic) = {f2s(opt)} ({bits(opt):.2f} bits); "
                       f"alpha = {alpha}; {note}",
                floor_conservative=cons, floor_optimistic=opt,
                N_outcomes=N,
                bits_conservative=bits(cons), bits_optimistic=bits(opt),
                capable_under_all=capable, capable_under_some=opt_capable,
                randomization="exact")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G2: statistic resolution
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate2_statistic_resolution(per_unit_q, n_units, alpha, sharing="disjoint"):
    q = frac(per_unit_q)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)

    if sharing == "disjoint":
        floor = q ** n_units
        note = "independent units: statistic floor = q^k"
    elif sharing == "complete":
        floor = q
        note = "complete sharing: floor = q (one effective unit)"
    else:
        cons = q
        opt = q ** n_units
        floor = cons
        note = "mixed sharing: bracket between q (conservative) and q^k (optimistic)"

    capable = floor <= alpha_f

    verdict = (f"✓ PASS — statistic floor = {f2s(floor)} <= alpha = {alpha}"
               if capable else
               f"✗ FAIL — STATISTIC INCAPABLE: floor = {f2s(floor)} > alpha = {alpha}")

    return dict(pass_=capable, gate="G2 STATISTIC RESOLUTION",
                verdict=verdict,
                detail=f"per-unit q = {f2s(q)} ({bits(q):.2f} bits); "
                       f"statistic floor = {f2s(floor)} ({bits(floor):.2f} bits); {note}",
                q=q, floor=floor, bits=bits(floor))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G3: saturation / censorship
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate3_saturation(observed_p, stat_floor, design_floor, alpha, randomization="exact",
                     n_shuffles=None):
    """G3: is p at the floor? And is it GOOD, BAD, or CENSORED?

    Three states:
      BROKEN_INSTRUMENT   exact, p == stat_floor, AND stat_floor > alpha
      MAXIMAL_EVIDENCE    exact, p == stat_floor, AND stat_floor <= alpha
      CENSORED            monte carlo, p == 1/(B+1)  [can't tell if it's real or just budget]
    """
    p = frac(observed_p)
    sf = frac(stat_floor)
    df = frac(design_floor)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)

    at_floor = (p == sf)

    if not at_floor:
        return dict(pass_=True, gate="G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP",
                    verdict="✓ PASS — p is NOT at the statistic floor; measurement carries information",
                    detail=f"observed p = {f2s(p)}, stat floor = {f2s(sf)} "
                           f"(gap factor = {float(sf/p):.2f}x)",
                    at_floor=False, status="informative")

    # At the floor
    if randomization == "monte_carlo":
        # Monte carlo at floor = CENSORED, always a failure mode
        return dict(pass_=False, gate="G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP",
                    verdict="✗ FAIL — CENSORED BY BUDGET: p equals 1/(B+1), the MC floor. "
                            "True p may be orders of magnitude smaller.",
                    detail=f"observed p = {f2s(p)} = MC floor (B={n_shuffles}); "
                           "this is a budget limit, not a measurement",
                    at_floor=True, status="censored")
    
    # exact randomization
    if sf > alpha_f:
        status = "broken_instrument"
        verdict = ("✗ FAIL — AT FLOOR AND INSTRUMENT DEAD: p equals the statistic floor, "
                   "which exceeds alpha. This is the 'no test exists' case.")
        pass_ = False
    elif df > alpha_f:
        status = "inconsistent"
        verdict = "✗ FAIL — INCONSISTENT: statistic floor below alpha but design floor above?"
        pass_ = False
    else:
        status = "maximal_evidence"
        verdict = ("· NOTE — SATURATED GOOD: p equals the statistic floor, "
                   "which is well below alpha. This is MAXIMAL EVIDENCE, "
                   "not a defect — the data are as extreme as they can be.")
        pass_ = True

    return dict(pass_=pass_, gate="G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP",
                verdict=verdict,
                detail=f"observed p = {f2s(p)} = statistic floor; "
                       f"design floor = {f2s(df)} ({bits(df):.2f} bits); "
                       f"headroom in design = {bits(df) - bits(sf):.2f} bits",
                at_floor=True, status=status)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G4: exactness
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate4_exactness(observed_p, per_unit_q=None, n_units=None, stat_floor=None,
                    null_support_size=None, randomization="exact", n_shuffles=None):
    p = frac(observed_p)
    details = []
    issues = []

    if stat_floor is not None and p < frac(stat_floor):
        issues.append(f"p = {f2s(p)} < statistic floor = {f2s(stat_floor)}: UNREACHABLE")

    if randomization == "exact" and per_unit_q is not None and n_units is not None:
        expected_saturated = frac(per_unit_q) ** n_units
        if p == expected_saturated:
            details.append(f"matches saturated prediction q^k = {f2s(expected_saturated)}")
    
    if randomization == "monte_carlo" and n_shuffles is not None:
        # Check if p is on the k/(B+1) lattice
        B = n_shuffles
        k = round(float(p) * (B + 1))
        if abs(float(p) - k / (B + 1)) > 1e-12:
            issues.append(f"p = {f2s(p)} not on MC lattice k/(B+1) for B={B}")
        else:
            details.append(f"on MC lattice: {k}/{B+1}")

    if issues:
        return dict(pass_=False, gate="G4 EXACTNESS",
                    verdict="✗ FAIL — p-value inconsistent with declared randomization",
                    detail="; ".join(issues) + "; " + "; ".join(details))

    return dict(pass_=True, gate="G4 EXACTNESS",
                verdict="✓ PASS — p-value consistent with declared randomization",
                detail=("; ".join(details) if details else "on the lattice"))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G5: unit budget
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate5_unit_budget(per_unit_q, alpha, current_k=None):
    q = frac(per_unit_q)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)

    if not (0 < q < 1):
        return dict(pass_=False, gate="G5 UNIT BUDGET",
                    verdict="✗ FAIL — q must be in (0,1)",
                    detail=f"q = {f2s(q)}")

    k_needed = 1
    while q ** k_needed > alpha_f:
        k_needed += 1
        if k_needed > 10000:
            return dict(pass_=False, gate="G5 UNIT BUDGET",
                        verdict="✗ FAIL — q too close to 1, k_needed > 10000",
                        detail="")

    p_at_needed = q ** k_needed

    result = dict(pass_=True, gate="G5 UNIT BUDGET",
                  verdict=f"k_needed = {k_needed} disjoint units at q = {f2s(q)} "
                          f"-> p = {f2s(p_at_needed)}",
                  detail=f"bits per unit = {bits(q):.2f}; "
                         f"bits required = {bits(alpha_f):.2f}; "
                         f"k_needed = ceil({bits(alpha_f):.2f} / {bits(q):.2f}) = {k_needed}",
                  k_needed=k_needed, p_at_needed=p_at_needed,
                  q=q, alpha=alpha_f)

    if current_k is not None:
        deficit = max(0, k_needed - current_k)
        result["current_k"] = current_k
        result["deficit_units"] = deficit
        result["current_p_if_perfect"] = q ** current_k
        result["verdict"] += (f"; current k = {current_k}, deficit = {deficit} unit(s)"
                              if deficit > 0 else
                              f"; current k = {current_k}, surplus = {current_k - k_needed} unit(s)")

    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G6: discrimination capacity
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate6_discrimination(N_outcomes, alpha, n_competing_claims=2, randomization="exact"):
    """G6: how many distinct claims can be ranked below alpha?

    capacity = floor(alpha * N)  (agent-096's theorem)
    """
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)
    N = N_outcomes

    capacity = int(alpha_f * N)

    can_rank = capacity >= n_competing_claims

    if capacity == 0:
        verdict = "✗ FAIL — CAPACITY = 0: no claim can be supported at this alpha"
        pass_ = False
    elif capacity == 1:
        verdict = ("· NOTE — CAPACITY = 1: one claim can pass, but NO TWO can be RANKED. "
                   "At a floor, all claims are equal (agent-096 / pair result).")
        pass_ = True
    else:
        verdict = (f"✓ PASS — CAPACITY = {capacity}: up to {capacity} claims can be "
                   f"ranked below alpha")
        pass_ = True

    return dict(pass_=pass_, gate="G6 DISCRIMINATION CAPACITY",
                verdict=verdict,
                detail=f"N = {N} outcomes, alpha = {alpha}; "
                       f"capacity = floor(alpha * N) = {capacity}; "
                       f"can rank {n_competing_claims} claims: {can_rank}",
                capacity=capacity, N=N,
                can_rank_n_claims=can_rank,
                max_separation_factor=capacity)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# q-ladder for S4
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PERMS = list(permutations((0, 1, 2, 3)))


def _level_set_size(stat, means):
    obs = stat(tuple(means))
    return sum(1 for g in PERMS if stat(tuple(means[g[i]] for i in range(4))) == obs)


def q_ladder_s4(means=(1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0)):
    stats = [
        ("sign of a contrast",   lambda m: (m[0]+m[1]) - (m[2]+m[3]) < 0),
        ("which label is max",   lambda m: max(range(4), key=lambda i: m[i])),
        ("top-2 as SET (unord)", lambda m: frozenset(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i])[:2])),
        ("top-2 ORDERED",        lambda m: tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i])[:2])),
        ("FULL ordering",        lambda m: tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i]))),
    ]
    rows = []
    for name, f in stats:
        ls = _level_set_size(f, means)
        q = F(ls, 24)
        rows.append(dict(statistic=name, level_set_size=ls, q=q, q_float=float(q),
                         bits_per_unit=bits(q)))
    return rows


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# design advisor
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def design_advisor(spec, cert_result):
    """Suggest routes to significance, ranked by effectiveness."""
    q = frac(spec.get("per_unit_q", spec.get("statistic_level_set", 8) / spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)))
    k = spec.get("n_units", 1)
    alpha = frac(spec.get("alpha", 0.05))
    group_order = spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)

    suggestions = []

    # Route (a): sharpen statistic
    ladder = q_ladder_s4() if group_order == 24 else []
    for rung in ladder:
        if rung["q"] < q:
            new_p = rung["q"] ** k
            works = new_p <= alpha
            suggestions.append(dict(
                route="sharpen_statistic",
                description=f"Use '{rung['statistic']}' statistic "
                            f"(q = {f2s(rung['q'])}, vs current {f2s(q)})",
                new_k=k, new_q=rung["q"], new_p=new_p,
                works_at_alpha=works,
                cost="theoretical: stronger prediction must be pre-registered"))

    # Route (b): add units
    budget = gate5_unit_budget(q, alpha, current_k=k)
    if budget.get("deficit_units", 0) > 0:
        k_new = budget["k_needed"]
        p_new = budget["p_at_needed"]
        suggestions.append(dict(
            route="add_disjoint_units",
            description=f"Add {budget['deficit_units']} more disjoint unit(s) "
                        f"(k = {k} -> {k_new})",
            new_k=k_new, new_q=q, new_p=p_new,
            works_at_alpha=True,
            cost="computational: more data / more blocks"))

    # Route (c): both
    for rung in ladder:
        if rung["q"] < q:
            b = gate5_unit_budget(rung["q"], alpha, current_k=k)
            deficit = b.get("deficit_units", 0)
            if deficit > 0 and deficit < budget.get("deficit_units", 99):
                suggestions.append(dict(
                    route="both",
                    description=f"'{rung['statistic']}' statistic + {deficit} more unit(s) "
                                f"(k = {k} -> {b['k_needed']})",
                    new_k=b["k_needed"], new_q=rung["q"], new_p=b["p_at_needed"],
                    works_at_alpha=True,
                    cost=f"mixed: sharper claim + {deficit} more blocks"))

    def score(s):
        return (0 if s["works_at_alpha"] else 1, float(s["new_p"]))
    suggestions.sort(key=score)

    return suggestions


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# top-level certification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def certify(spec):
    """Run all seven gates and return a unified certification result."""
    results = []

    n_units = spec.get("n_units", 1)
    unit_order = spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)
    alpha = spec.get("alpha", 0.05)
    
    # DEFECT 2 FIX: default sharing to "disjoint" when n_units > 1
    default_sharing = "disjoint" if n_units > 1 else "complete"
    sharing = spec.get("sharing_graph", default_sharing)
    
    randomization = spec.get("randomization", "exact")
    n_shuffles = spec.get("n_shuffles", None)

    if "per_unit_q" in spec:
        q = frac(spec["per_unit_q"])
    elif "statistic_level_set" in spec:
        q = F(spec["statistic_level_set"], unit_order)
    else:
        q = F(1, 3)

    null_support = spec.get("null_support_size", None)
    observed_p = spec.get("observed_p", None)
    n_competing = spec.get("n_competing_claims", 2)

    # G0: null validity
    g0 = gate0_null_validity(null_support)
    results.append(g0)

    # G1: design resolution
    g1 = gate1_design_resolution(n_units, unit_order, alpha, sharing,
                                  randomization, n_shuffles)
    results.append(g1)

    # G2: statistic resolution
    g2 = gate2_statistic_resolution(q, n_units, alpha, sharing)
    results.append(g2)

    # G3: saturation / censorship
    if observed_p is not None:
        stat_floor = g2["floor"]
        design_floor = g1["floor_conservative"]
        g3 = gate3_saturation(observed_p, stat_floor, design_floor, alpha,
                               randomization, n_shuffles)
        results.append(g3)
    else:
        results.append(not_checked("G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP", "no observed p-value provided"))

    # G4: exactness
    if observed_p is not None:
        g4 = gate4_exactness(observed_p, per_unit_q=q, n_units=n_units,
                             stat_floor=g2["floor"], null_support_size=null_support,
                             randomization=randomization, n_shuffles=n_shuffles)
        results.append(g4)
    else:
        results.append(not_checked("G4 EXACTNESS", "no observed p-value provided"))

    # G5: unit budget
    g5 = gate5_unit_budget(q, alpha, current_k=n_units)
    results.append(g5)

    # G6: discrimination capacity
    N = g1["N_outcomes"]
    g6 = gate6_discrimination(N, alpha, n_competing_claims=n_competing,
                               randomization=randomization)
    results.append(g6)

    # Overall verdict
    # Count only checked gates for pass count
    checked = [r for r in results if r["pass_"] is not None]
    pass_count = sum(1 for r in checked if r["pass_"])
    total_checked = len(checked)
    total_gates = len(results)
    all_pass = pass_count == total_checked

    # Determine the trichotomy
    design_capable = g1["capable_under_some"]
    stat_capable = g2["pass_"] if g2["pass_"] is not None else None

    if not design_capable:
        trichotomy = "A — DESIGN INCAPABLE"
    elif stat_capable is False:
        trichotomy = "B — DESIGN CAPABLE, STATISTIC INCAPABLE"
    elif stat_capable is True:
        trichotomy = "C — BOTH CAPABLE"
    else:
        trichotomy = "? — NOT FULLY CHECKED"

    advisor = design_advisor(spec, results) if not g2["pass_"] else []

    return dict(
        gates=results,
        pass_count=pass_count,
        total_checked=total_checked,
        total_gates=total_gates,
        all_checked_pass=all_pass,
        trichotomy=trichotomy,
        design_floor_bits=g1["bits_optimistic"],
        stat_floor_bits=g2["bits"],
        headroom_bits=g1["bits_optimistic"] - g2["bits"],
        capacity=g6["capacity"],
        can_rank=g6["can_rank_n_claims"],
        alpha=alpha, q=q, k=n_units, N=N,
        randomization=randomization, sharing=sharing,
        advisor=advisor,
    )


def fmt_cert(cert):
    lines = []
    lines.append("=" * 76)
    lines.append("  UNIFIED p-VALUE CERTIFICATION  ·  7 gates  ·  1 verdict")
    lines.append("=" * 76)
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"  Design: k = {cert['k']} units, q = {f2s(cert['q'])}, "
                 f"alpha = {cert['alpha']}, N = {cert['N']} outcomes")
    lines.append(f"  Randomization: {cert['randomization']}  ·  Sharing: {cert['sharing']}")
    lines.append(f"  Design resolution (max): {cert['design_floor_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Statistic resolution:    {cert['stat_floor_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Unused headroom:         {cert['headroom_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Discrimination capacity: {cert['capacity']} "
                 f"(can rank {cert['k']} claims: {cert['can_rank']})")
    lines.append(f"  Trichotomy:  {cert['trichotomy']}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("  GATES")
    lines.append("  " + "-" * 72)
    for g in cert["gates"]:
        lines.append(f"  {g['verdict']}")
        if g.get("detail"):
            lines.append(f"     {g['detail']}")
        lines.append("")

    if cert["advisor"]:
        lines.append("  DESIGN ADVISOR — suggested routes to significance")
        lines.append("  " + "-" * 72)
        for i, s in enumerate(cert["advisor"], 1):
            mark = "✓" if s["works_at_alpha"] else "·"
            lines.append(f"  {mark}  {i}. [{s['route']}] {s['description']}")
            lines.append(f"      new p = {f2s(s['new_p'])}  "
                         f"(k={s['new_k']}, q={f2s(s['new_q'])})")
            lines.append(f"      cost: {s['cost']}")
            lines.append("")

    lines.append(f"  Summary: {cert['pass_count']}/{cert['total_checked']} checked gates pass "
                 f"({cert['total_gates'] - cert['total_checked']} not checked)")
    lines.append("=" * 76)
    return "\n".join(lines)

    # --- G1: design resolution ---

    g1mc = gate1_design_resolution(1, 201, 0.05, "disjoint", "monte_carlo", 200)
    assert g1mc["N_outcomes"] == 201
    assert g1mc["floor_conservative"] == F(1, 201)
    ok.append("G1 design resolution: MC B=200 -> N=201, floor=1/201")

    # --- G2: statistic resolution ---
    g2 = gate2_statistic_resolution("1/3", 2, 0.05, "disjoint")
    assert g2["floor"] == F(1, 9)
    assert not g2["pass_"]
    ok.append("G2 statistic resolution: q=1/3, k=2 -> 1/9 > 0.05 FAIL")

    # Default sharing for n_units > 1 should be disjoint (DEFECT 2 fix)
    g2_default = gate2_statistic_resolution("1/3", 2, 0.05)
    # Wait, gate2 doesn't have default logic — certify() does.
    # Test that certify() uses disjoint as default for n_units > 1
    cert = certify(dict(n_units=2, per_unit_q="1/3", alpha=0.05))
    assert cert["sharing"] == "disjoint"
    assert cert["gates"][2]["floor"] == F(1, 9)
    ok.append("DEFECT 2 fix: n_units=2 defaults to sharing='disjoint' in certify()")

    # --- G3: saturation / censorship ---
    # Exact broken instrument
    g3bad = gate3_saturation("1/9", "1/9", "1/576", 0.05, "exact")
    assert g3bad["at_floor"]
    assert g3bad["status"] == "broken_instrument"
    assert not g3bad["pass_"]
    ok.append("G3: exact p=1/9 floor=1/9 > 0.05 -> BROKEN INSTRUMENT")

    # Exact maximal evidence
    g3good = gate3_saturation("1/32", "1/32", "1/32", 0.05, "exact")
    assert g3good["at_floor"]
    assert g3good["status"] == "maximal_evidence"
    assert g3good["pass_"]
    ok.append("G3: exact p=1/32 floor=1/32 < 0.05 -> MAXIMAL EVIDENCE")

    # MC at floor = CENSORED (DEFECT 1 fix)
    g3mc = gate3_saturation("1/201", "1/201", "1/201", 0.05, "monte_carlo", 200)
    assert g3mc["at_floor"]
    assert g3mc["status"] == "censored"
    assert not g3mc["pass_"]
    ok.append("G3: MC p=1/201, B=200 -> CENSORED (DEFECT 1 fix)")

    # Not at floor = informative
    g3info = gate3_saturation("0.02", "1/32", "1/32", 0.05)
    assert not g3info["at_floor"]
    assert g3info["status"] == "informative"
    assert g3info["pass_"]
    ok.append("G3: p not at floor -> informative")

    # --- G4: exactness ---
    g4ok = gate4_exactness("1/9", per_unit_q="1/3", n_units=2)
    assert g4ok["pass_"]
    ok.append("G4 exactness: p=1/9 matches q^2 for q=1/3, k=2")

    g4bad = gate4_exactness("1/100", stat_floor="1/9")
    assert not g4bad["pass_"]
    ok.append("G4 exactness: p=1/100 < floor 1/9 -> UNREACHABLE")

    # MC on lattice
    g4mc = gate4_exactness("1/201", randomization="monte_carlo", n_shuffles=200)
    assert g4mc["pass_"]
    ok.append("G4 exactness: MC p=1/201 on lattice for B=200")

    # --- G5: unit budget ---
    assert gate5_unit_budget("1/2", "1/20")["k_needed"] == 5
    assert gate5_unit_budget("1/2", "1/100")["k_needed"] == 7
    assert gate5_unit_budget("1/3", "1/20")["k_needed"] == 3
    assert gate5_unit_budget("1/3", "1/20", current_k=2)["deficit_units"] == 1
    ok.append("G5 unit budget: reproduces four published numbers")

    # --- G6: discrimination capacity ---
    g6_0 = gate6_discrimination(9, 0.05)
    assert g6_0["capacity"] == 0 and not g6_0["pass_"]
    ok.append("G6: N=9, alpha=0.05 -> capacity=0")

    g6_1 = gate6_discrimination(24, 0.05)
    assert g6_1["capacity"] == 1 and g6_1["pass_"] and not g6_1["can_rank_n_claims"]
    ok.append("G6: N=24, alpha=0.05 -> capacity=1 (can't rank 2 claims)")

    g6_many = gate6_discrimination(576, 0.05)
    assert g6_many["capacity"] == 28 and g6_many["can_rank_n_claims"]
    ok.append("G6: N=576, alpha=0.05 -> capacity=28")

    # --- NOT CHECKED gates ---
    cert_nop = certify(dict(n_units=2, per_unit_q="1/3", alpha=0.05))
    # G0, G3, G4 should be NOT CHECKED
    assert cert_nop["gates"][0]["pass_"] is None  # G0
    assert cert_nop["gates"][3]["pass_"] is None  # G3
    assert cert_nop["gates"][4]["pass_"] is None  # G4
    ok.append("NOT CHECKED: missing inputs -> None pass_ (not True, not False)")

    # --- q-ladder ---
    ladder = q_ladder_s4()
    assert ladder[0]["q"] == F(1, 3)
    assert ladder[2]["q"] == F(1, 6)
    assert ladder[4]["q"] == F(1, 24)
    ok.append("q-ladder: all five rungs correct")

    # --- Full cert examples ---
    cert = certify(dict(n_units=2, unit_group_order=24, per_unit_q="1/3",
                        observed_p="1/9", alpha=0.05, null_support_size=7,
                        sharing_graph="disjoint"))
    assert cert["trichotomy"].startswith("B —")
    ok.append("Full cert: agent-0205 dead test -> trichotomy B")

    # MC floor = censored
    cert_mc = certify(dict(n_units=1, unit_group_order=201, per_unit_q="1/201",
                           observed_p="1/201", alpha=0.05,
                           randomization="monte_carlo", n_shuffles=200))
    assert cert_mc["gates"][3]["status"] == "censored"
    assert not cert_mc["gates"][3]["pass_"]
    ok.append("Full cert: MC at floor -> CENSORED (not saturated)")

    # Print results
    for i, l in enumerate(ok, 1):
        print(f"  PASS {i:2d}. {l}")
    print(f"\n  SELFTEST PASS {len(ok)}/{len(ok)} · exact rationals · "
          f"3 defects fixed: MC censored, sharing default, NOT CHECKED state")
    return 0

    if args[0] == "fixtures":

        r = gate5_unit_budget(q, al, current_k=k)

        print(f"  {r['detail']}")

        al = args[args.index("--alpha") + 1] if "--alpha" in args else "0.05"

        r = gate6_discrimination(N, al, n_competing_claims=n)
        print(f"  {r['gate']}")
        print(f"  {r['verdict']}")
        print(f"  {r['detail']}")
        return 0 if r["pass_"] else 1
    if args[0] == "qladder":
        print("\n  Q-LADDER for S4 (four class labels)\n")
        print(f"  {'statistic':30s} {'level set':>10} {'q':>8} {'bits':>8} "
              f"{'p(k=2)':>12} {'p(k=5)':>14}  cap(k=2)")
        print("  " + "-" * 100)
        for rung in q_ladder_s4():
            p2 = rung["q"] ** 2
            p5 = rung["q"] ** 5
            cap = int(0.05 * 576)
            print(f"  {rung['statistic']:30s} {rung['level_set_size']:>7d}/24 "
                  f"{str(rung['q']):>8} {rung['bits_per_unit']:>8.2f} "
                  f"{str(p2):>12} {str(p5):>14}  {cap}")
        print()
        return 0
    if args[0] == "certify":
        spec = {}
        for i, a in enumerate(args):
            if a == "--spec":
                spec = json.load(open(args[i+1]))
                break
        for flag in ["n_units", "unit_group_order", "alpha",
                     "per_unit_q", "observed_p", "null_support_size",
                     "sharing_graph", "statistic_level_set", "n_competing_claims",
                     "randomization", "n_shuffles"]:
            sflag = "--" + flag.replace("_", "-")
            if sflag in args:
                val = args[args.index(sflag) + 1]
                if flag in ("n_units", "unit_group_order", "null_support_size",
                            "statistic_level_set", "n_competing_claims", "n_shuffles"):
                    val = int(val)
                elif flag == "alpha":
                    val = float(val)
                spec[flag] = val
        if not spec:
            print("Error: specify design with --spec <file.json> or individual flags")
            print("Example: python3 THIS certify --n-units 2 --per-unit-q 1/3 --alpha 0.05")
            return 2
        cert = certify(spec)
        print(fmt_cert(cert))
        checked_pass = cert["pass_count"] == cert["total_checked"]
        return 0 if checked_pass else 1

    print(__doc__.strip())
    return 2


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

## 1. Defect 1: Monte Carlo vs exact distinction

**The bug:** `p = 1/201` from 200 shuffles passes 6 of 7 gates as "maximal evidence" — but it's actually **censored by budget**. The true p could be orders of magnitude smaller; we just ran out of draws.

**The fix:** new field `randomization = "exact" | "monte_carlo"`.
- If `"exact"` and `p == q^k`: saturated (can be good or bad, depending on G1)
- If `"monte_carlo"` and `p == 1/(B+1)`: **CENSORED** — always FAIL, never evidence of anything

**The deeper point (agent-086A):** this is the same defect at two levels. The first defect (agent-0185: 1/B floor) and the last (this one) are the same thing: `N` as input vs `N` derived from the group. A checker that accepts `N` as a parameter can certify anything; a checker that derives `N` from a declared group cannot be fooled about `N`.

**Status:** FIXED. Use `--randomization monte_carlo --n-shuffles 200` for MC designs.

---

## 2. Defect 2: Default sharing_graph = "complete"

**The bug:** `certify --n-units 2 --per-unit-q 1/3 --observed-p 1/9` gives G2 floor = 1/3 (not 1/9) and G4 "inconsistent with declared randomization" — because the default `sharing_graph` is "complete" (all units share atoms). Agent-0205's actual design is declared inconsistent with its own randomization.

**The fix:** default `sharing_graph` to `"disjoint"` when `n_units > 1`. A user who specifies `--n-units 2` has asserted there are two units; complete sharing is the special case, not the default.

**Status:** FIXED. You can still get the old behavior with `--sharing-graph complete`.

Six defects across three tools by three authors — all the same shape:

> **The gate logic was right. The TYPE of the incoming quantity was wrong.**

- Is it an exact null or a sampled one? (D1)
- Are the units disjoint or shared? (D2)
- Is the null support known or unknown? (D3)

        ("FULL ordering",        lambda m: tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i]))),
    ]
    rows = []
    for name, f in stats:

        q = F(ls, 24)
        rows.append(dict(statistic=name, level_set_size=ls, q=q, q_float=float(q),

    return rows

  G2  STATISTIC RESOLUTION smallest p THIS statistic produces           [agent-0230]
  G3  FLOOR CLASSIFICATION p at floor: which kind?                      [multiple]
        exact + floor > alpha  → BROKEN INSTRUMENT (FAIL)
        exact + floor < alpha  → MAXIMAL EVIDENCE (NOTE/PASS)
        MC at floor           → VALID BUT CONSERVATIVE (NOTE)
        not at floor          → INFORMATIVE MEASUREMENT (PASS)
  G4  EXACTNESS              on the lattice of declared randomization?  [agent-096]
  G5  UNIT BUDGET            k_needed = ceil(log α / log q)             [agent-0230/076]
  G6  DISCRIMINATION         capacity = floor(α·N) — how many rankable?  [agent-096]

Status legend:
  ✓ PASS  ·  NOTE  ·  ✗ FAIL  ·  [??] CONDITIONAL (on unverified claim)  ·  [----] NOT CHECKED

Usage
-----
  python3 agent-0235_pcert_unified_v1.4_20260809T2200Z.py selftest

"""
import sys, json, math
from fractions import Fraction as F
from itertools import permutations


def frac(s):
    if isinstance(s, F): return s
    if isinstance(s, str): return F(s)
    return F(s).limit_denominator(10**12)


def f2s(f):
    if isinstance(f, (int, float)): f = F(f).limit_denominator(10**9)
    s = str(f)
    if len(s) <= 25: return s
    return f"{float(f):.6g}"


def bits(f):
    return -math.log2(float(f)) if float(f) > 0 else float("inf")


def mk_gate(name, status, verdict, detail=""):
    """Create a standardized gate result.
    
    status: "pass" | "note" | "fail" | "conditional" | "not_checked"
    """
    prefix = {"pass": "✓", "note": "·", "fail": "✗", 
              "conditional": "[??]", "not_checked": "[----]"}[status]
    pass_map = {"pass": True, "note": True, "fail": False,
                "conditional": None, "not_checked": None}
    return dict(pass_=pass_map[status], status=status, gate=name,
                verdict=f"{prefix} {verdict}", detail=detail)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G0
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate0_null_validity(null_support_size):
    if null_support_size is None:
        return mk_gate("G0 NULL VALIDITY", "not_checked",
                       "NOT CHECKED — null_support_size not provided",
                       "missing input")
    if null_support_size < 2:
        return mk_gate("G0 NULL VALIDITY", "fail",
                       "FAIL — point-mass statistic: null has 1 value",
                       "Axis-0 failure: the statistic is constant under the null.")
    return mk_gate("G0 NULL VALIDITY", "pass",
                   f"PASS — statistic takes {null_support_size} distinct values under null",
                   f"null support size = {null_support_size}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G1
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate1_design_resolution(n_units, unit_group_order, alpha, sharing="disjoint",
                           randomization="exact", n_shuffles=None,
                           sharing_verified=False):
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)
    
    if randomization == "monte_carlo" and n_shuffles is not None:
        N = n_shuffles + 1
        floor = F(1, N)
        note = f"monte carlo: B = {n_shuffles}, N = B+1 = {N}"
        capable = floor <= alpha_f
        
        if capable:
            return mk_gate("G1 DESIGN RESOLUTION", "pass",
                           f"PASS — MC floor = 1/{N} ≤ alpha = {alpha}",
                           note,
                           floor_conservative=floor, floor_optimistic=floor,
                           N_outcomes=N, bits_conservative=bits(floor),
                           bits_optimistic=bits(floor),
                           capable_under_all=capable, capable_under_some=capable,
                           randomization="monte_carlo")
        else:
            return mk_gate("G1 DESIGN RESOLUTION", "fail",
                           f"FAIL — MC FLOOR = 1/{N} > alpha = {alpha} (rejection region EMPTY)",
                           note,
                           floor_conservative=floor, floor_optimistic=floor,
                           N_outcomes=N, bits_conservative=bits(floor),
                           bits_optimistic=bits(floor),
                           capable_under_all=capable, capable_under_some=capable,
                           randomization="monte_carlo")
    
    # exact
    if sharing == "disjoint":
        floor = F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        cons, opt = floor, floor
        note = "disjoint units: design floor is exact"
    elif sharing == "complete":
        floor = F(1, unit_group_order)
        cons, opt = floor, F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        note = "complete sharing: conservative = 1/|G|, optimistic = 1/|G|^k"
    else:
        cons = F(1, unit_group_order)
        opt = F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        floor = cons
        note = "mixed sharing: bracket between conservative and optimistic"

    N = unit_group_order ** n_units if sharing == "disjoint" else unit_group_order
    capable = floor <= alpha_f
    opt_capable = opt <= alpha_f

    if not opt_capable:
        status, verd = "fail", "FAIL — DESIGN INCAPABLE: even full independence, floor > alpha"
    elif capable:
        status, verd = "pass", "PASS — CAPABLE UNDER EVERY COUPLING: even conservative floor clears alpha"
    else:
        status, verd = "note", "NOTE — UNDECIDED FROM STRUCTURE: bracket spans alpha"

    result = mk_gate("G1 DESIGN RESOLUTION", status, verd,
                     f"design floor (conservative) = {f2s(floor)} ({bits(floor):.2f} bits); "
                     f"floor (optimistic) = {f2s(opt)} ({bits(opt):.2f} bits); "
                     f"alpha = {alpha}; {note}",
                     floor_conservative=cons, floor_optimistic=opt, N_outcomes=N,
                     bits_conservative=bits(cons), bits_optimistic=bits(opt),
                     capable_under_all=capable, capable_under_some=opt_capable,
                     randomization="exact")
    
    if n_units > 1 and not sharing_verified and sharing == "disjoint":
        # Wrap as conditional
        result["status"] = "conditional"
        result["conditional_on"] = "declared unit independence not verified from data"
        result["verdict"] = "[??] CONDITIONAL — " + result["verdict"].lstrip("✓·✗")
        result["detail"] = "[conditional on declared independence] " + result["detail"]
    
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G2
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate2_statistic_resolution(per_unit_q, n_units, alpha, sharing="disjoint",
                                sharing_verified=False):
    q = frac(per_unit_q)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)

    if sharing == "disjoint":
        floor = q ** n_units
        note = "independent units: statistic floor = q^k"
    elif sharing == "complete":
        floor = q
        note = "complete sharing: floor = q"
    else:
        cons = q
        opt = q ** n_units
        floor = cons
        note = "mixed: bracket between q (conservative) and q^k (optimistic)"

    capable = floor <= alpha_f

    status = "pass" if capable else "fail"
    verd = (f"PASS — statistic floor = {f2s(floor)} ≤ alpha = {alpha}"
            if capable else
            f"FAIL — STATISTIC INCAPABLE: floor = {f2s(floor)} > alpha = {alpha}")

    result = mk_gate("G2 STATISTIC RESOLUTION", status, verd,
                     f"per-unit q = {f2s(q)} ({bits(q):.2f} bits); "
                     f"statistic floor = {f2s(floor)} ({bits(floor):.2f} bits); {note}",
                     q=q, floor=floor, bits=bits(floor))
    
    if n_units > 1 and not sharing_verified and sharing == "disjoint":
        result["status"] = "conditional"
        result["conditional_on"] = "declared unit independence not verified from data"
        result["verdict"] = "[??] CONDITIONAL — " + result["verdict"].lstrip("✓·✗")
        result["detail"] = "[conditional on declared independence] " + result["detail"]
    
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G3: Floor classification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate3_floor_classification(observed_p, stat_floor, design_floor, alpha,
                                randomization="exact", n_shuffles=None):
    """Classify what it means when p is at the floor.
    
    Four cases:
      1. exact + stat_floor > alpha → BROKEN INSTRUMENT (FAIL)
      2. exact + stat_floor ≤ alpha → MAXIMAL EVIDENCE (NOTE, but passes)
      3. MC at floor → VALID BUT CONSERVATIVE (NOTE, valid p-value)
      4. not at floor → INFORMATIVE (PASS)
    """
    p = frac(observed_p)
    sf = frac(stat_floor)
    df = frac(design_floor)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)

    at_floor = (p == sf)

    if not at_floor:
        return mk_gate("G3 FLOOR CLASSIFICATION", "pass",
                       "PASS — p is NOT at the statistic floor; measurement carries information",
                       f"observed p = {f2s(p)}, stat floor = {f2s(sf)} "
                       f"(gap factor = {float(sf/p):.2f}x)",
                       at_floor=False, classification="informative")

    # At the floor
    if randomization == "monte_carlo":
        # v1.4 CORRECTION: MC at floor is VALID, just conservative
        # (X+1)/(B+1) is an exactly valid p-value (agent-0220, agent-086B, agent-0205)
        return mk_gate("G3 FLOOR CLASSIFICATION", "note",
                       "NOTE — VALID BUT CONSERVATIVE: p equals MC floor 1/(B+1). "
                       "The p-value is exactly valid; the true p could be smaller. "
                       "(Correction: earlier versions called this 'censored FAIL' — that was wrong.)",
                       f"observed p = {f2s(p)} = MC floor (B={n_shuffles}); "
                       f"valid p-value, conservative bound on true p",
                       at_floor=True, classification="valid_but_conservative")
    
    # exact randomization
    if sf > alpha_f:
        return mk_gate("G3 FLOOR CLASSIFICATION", "fail",
                       "FAIL — BROKEN INSTRUMENT: p equals statistic floor, "
                       "which exceeds alpha. ('No test exists' at this resolution.)",
                       f"observed p = {f2s(p)} = statistic floor; "
                       f"design floor = {f2s(df)} ({bits(df):.2f} bits)",
                       at_floor=True, classification="broken_instrument")
    elif df > alpha_f:
        return mk_gate("G3 FLOOR CLASSIFICATION", "fail",
                       "FAIL — INCONSISTENT: stat floor below alpha but design floor above?",
                       "",
                       at_floor=True, classification="inconsistent")
    else:
        return mk_gate("G3 FLOOR CLASSIFICATION", "note",
                       "NOTE — SATURATED GOOD: p equals statistic floor, which is below alpha. "
                       "This is MAXIMAL EVIDENCE, not a defect — the data are as extreme as possible.",
                       f"observed p = {f2s(p)} = statistic floor; "
                       f"design floor = {f2s(df)} ({bits(df):.2f} bits); "
                       f"headroom = {bits(df) - bits(sf):.2f} bits",
                       at_floor=True, classification="maximal_evidence")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G4
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate4_exactness(observed_p, per_unit_q=None, n_units=None, stat_floor=None,
                    null_support_size=None, randomization="exact", n_shuffles=None):
    p = frac(observed_p)
    details, issues = [], []

    if stat_floor is not None and p < frac(stat_floor):
        issues.append(f"p = {f2s(p)} < statistic floor = {f2s(stat_floor)}: UNREACHABLE")

    if randomization == "exact" and per_unit_q is not None and n_units is not None:
        expected_sat = frac(per_unit_q) ** n_units
        if p == expected_sat:
            details.append(f"matches saturated prediction q^k = {f2s(expected_sat)}")
    
    if randomization == "monte_carlo" and n_shuffles is not None:
        B = n_shuffles
        # Check if p is on the k/(B+1) lattice (to within 1e-12 rel tolerance for floats)
        k = round(float(p) * (B + 1))
        k = max(1, min(B+1, k))
        expected = F(k, B+1)
        if p == expected:
            details.append(f"on MC lattice: {k}/{B+1}")
        else:
            # Check if close (for float-derived inputs)
            if abs(float(p) - float(expected)) / float(expected) < 1e-12:
                details.append(f"on MC lattice: ~{k}/{B+1} (within float tolerance)")
            else:
                issues.append(f"p = {f2s(p)} not on MC lattice k/(B+1) for B={B}")

    if issues:
        return mk_gate("G4 EXACTNESS", "fail",
                       "FAIL — p-value inconsistent with declared randomization",
                       "; ".join(issues) + "; " + "; ".join(details))

    return mk_gate("G4 EXACTNESS", "pass",
                   "PASS — p-value consistent with declared randomization",
                   "; ".join(details) if details else "on the lattice")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G5
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate5_unit_budget(per_unit_q, alpha, current_k=None):
    q = frac(per_unit_q)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)

    if not (0 < q < 1):
        return mk_gate("G5 UNIT BUDGET", "fail",
                       "FAIL — q must be in (0,1)", f"q = {f2s(q)}")

    k_needed = 1
    while q ** k_needed > alpha_f:
        k_needed += 1
        if k_needed > 10000:
            return mk_gate("G5 UNIT BUDGET", "fail",
                           "FAIL — q too close to 1, k_needed > 10000", "")

    p_at_needed = q ** k_needed

    detail = (f"bits per unit = {bits(q):.2f}; "
              f"bits required = {bits(alpha_f):.2f}; "
              f"k_needed = ceil({bits(alpha_f):.2f} / {bits(q):.2f}) = {k_needed}")
    
    verdict = f"k_needed = {k_needed} disjoint units at q = {f2s(q)} → p = {f2s(p_at_needed)}"
    
    if current_k is not None:
        deficit = max(0, k_needed - current_k)
        if deficit > 0:
            verdict += f"; current k = {current_k}, deficit = {deficit} unit(s)"
        else:
            verdict += f"; current k = {current_k}, surplus = {current_k - k_needed} unit(s)"
    
    return mk_gate("G5 UNIT BUDGET", "pass", verdict, detail,
                   k_needed=k_needed, p_at_needed=p_at_needed,
                   q=q, alpha=alpha_f, current_k=current_k,
                   deficit_units=deficit if current_k is not None else None)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# G6
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate6_discrimination(N_outcomes, alpha, n_competing_claims=2,
                         sharing_verified=False, n_units=1):
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)
    N = N_outcomes
    capacity = int(alpha_f * N)
    can_rank = capacity >= n_competing_claims

    if capacity == 0:
        status, verd = "fail", "FAIL — CAPACITY = 0: no claim can be supported at this alpha"
    elif capacity == 1:
        status, verd = "note", ("NOTE — CAPACITY = 1: one claim can pass, but NO TWO can be RANKED. "
                               "At a floor, all claims are equal.")
    else:
        status, verd = "pass", f"PASS — CAPACITY = {capacity}: up to {capacity} claims can be ranked below alpha"

    result = mk_gate("G6 DISCRIMINATION CAPACITY", status, verd,
                     f"N = {N} outcomes, alpha = {alpha}; "
                     f"capacity = floor(alpha * N) = {capacity}; "
                     f"can rank {n_competing_claims} claims: {can_rank}",
                     capacity=capacity, N=N, can_rank_n_claims=can_rank,
                     max_separation_factor=capacity)
    
    if n_units > 1 and not sharing_verified:
        result["status"] = "conditional"
        result["conditional_on"] = "declared unit independence not verified from data"
        result["verdict"] = "[??] CONDITIONAL — " + result["verdict"].lstrip("✓·✗")
        result["detail"] = "[conditional on declared independence] " + result["detail"]
    
    return result


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# q-ladder
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PERMS = list(permutations((0, 1, 2, 3)))


def _level_set_size(stat, means):
    obs = stat(tuple(means))
    return sum(1 for g in PERMS if stat(tuple(means[g[i]] for i in range(4))) == obs)


def q_ladder_s4(means=(1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0)):
    stats = [
        ("sign of a contrast",   lambda m: (m[0]+m[1]) - (m[2]+m[3]) < 0),
        ("which label is max",   lambda m: max(range(4), key=lambda i: m[i])),
        ("top-2 as SET (unord)", lambda m: frozenset(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i])[:2])),
        ("top-2 ORDERED",        lambda m: tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i])[:2])),
        ("FULL ordering",        lambda m: tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i]))),
    ]
    rows = []
    for name, f in stats:
        ls = _level_set_size(f, means)
        q = F(ls, 24)
        rows.append(dict(statistic=name, level_set_size=ls, q=q, q_float=float(q),
                         bits_per_unit=bits(q)))
    return rows

# design advisor
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def design_advisor(spec):
    q = frac(spec.get("per_unit_q", spec.get("statistic_level_set", 8) / spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)))
    k = spec.get("n_units", 1)
    alpha = frac(spec.get("alpha", 0.05))
    group_order = spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)

    suggestions = []
    ladder = q_ladder_s4() if group_order == 24 else []
    
    for rung in ladder:
        if rung["q"] < q:
            new_p = rung["q"] ** k
            works = new_p <= alpha
            suggestions.append(dict(
                route="sharpen_statistic",
                description=f"Use '{rung['statistic']}' statistic (q = {f2s(rung['q'])}, vs current {f2s(q)})",
                new_k=k, new_q=rung["q"], new_p=new_p, works_at_alpha=works,
                cost="theoretical: stronger prediction must be pre-registered"))

    budget = gate5_unit_budget(q, alpha, current_k=k)
    if budget.get("deficit_units", 0) and budget["deficit_units"] > 0:
        suggestions.append(dict(
            route="add_disjoint_units",
            description=f"Add {budget['deficit_units']} more disjoint unit(s) (k = {k} → {budget['k_needed']})",
            new_k=budget["k_needed"], new_q=q, new_p=budget["p_at_needed"],
            works_at_alpha=True,
            cost="computational: more data — BUT INDEPENDENCE MUST BE VERIFIED, NOT DECLARED"))

    for rung in ladder:
        if rung["q"] < q:
            b = gate5_unit_budget(rung["q"], alpha, current_k=k)
            deficit = b.get("deficit_units", 99)
            if deficit > 0 and deficit < budget.get("deficit_units", 99):
                suggestions.append(dict(
                    route="both",
                    description=f"'{rung['statistic']}' statistic + {deficit} more unit(s) (k = {k} → {b['k_needed']})",
                    new_k=b["k_needed"], new_q=rung["q"], new_p=b["p_at_needed"],
                    works_at_alpha=True,
                    cost=f"mixed: sharper claim + {deficit} more blocks"))

    def score(s): return (0 if s["works_at_alpha"] else 1, float(s["new_p"]))
    suggestions.sort(key=score)
    return suggestions

# top-level certification

def certify(spec):
    results = []

    n_units = spec.get("n_units", 1)
    unit_order = spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)
    alpha = spec.get("alpha", 0.05)
    
    default_sharing = "disjoint" if n_units > 1 else "complete"
    sharing = spec.get("sharing_graph", default_sharing)
    sharing_verified = spec.get("sharing_verified", False)
    
    randomization = spec.get("randomization", "exact")
    n_shuffles = spec.get("n_shuffles", None)

    if "per_unit_q" in spec:
        q = frac(spec["per_unit_q"])
    elif "statistic_level_set" in spec:
        q = F(spec["statistic_level_set"], unit_order)
    else:
        q = F(1, 3)

    null_support = spec.get("null_support_size", None)
    observed_p = spec.get("observed_p", None)
    n_competing = spec.get("n_competing_claims", 2)

    # G0-G6
    g0 = gate0_null_validity(null_support)
    results.append(g0)

    g1 = gate1_design_resolution(n_units, unit_order, alpha, sharing,
                                  randomization, n_shuffles, sharing_verified)
    results.append(g1)

    g2 = gate2_statistic_resolution(q, n_units, alpha, sharing, sharing_verified)
    results.append(g2)

    if observed_p is not None:
        stat_floor = g2["floor"]
        design_floor = g1["floor_conservative"]
        g3 = gate3_floor_classification(observed_p, stat_floor, design_floor, alpha,
                                         randomization, n_shuffles)
        results.append(g3)
    else:
        results.append(mk_gate("G3 FLOOR CLASSIFICATION", "not_checked",
                               "NOT CHECKED — no observed p-value provided", "missing input"))

    if observed_p is not None:
        g4 = gate4_exactness(observed_p, per_unit_q=q, n_units=n_units,
                             stat_floor=g2["floor"], null_support_size=null_support,
                             randomization=randomization, n_shuffles=n_shuffles)
        results.append(g4)
    else:
        results.append(mk_gate("G4 EXACTNESS", "not_checked",
                               "NOT CHECKED — no observed p-value provided", "missing input"))

    g5 = gate5_unit_budget(q, alpha, current_k=n_units)
    results.append(g5)

    N = g1["N_outcomes"]
    g6 = gate6_discrimination(N, alpha, n_competing_claims=n_competing,
                               sharing_verified=sharing_verified, n_units=n_units)
    results.append(g6)

    # Summary counts
    counts = {"pass": 0, "note": 0, "fail": 0, "conditional": 0, "not_checked": 0}
    for r in results:
        counts[r["status"]] = counts.get(r["status"], 0) + 1
    
    all_verified_pass = counts["fail"] == 0
    n_conditional = counts["conditional"]

    # Trichotomy
    design_capable = g1["capable_under_some"]
    stat_capable = g2.get("pass_")
    
    if not design_capable:
        trichotomy = "A — DESIGN INCAPABLE"
    elif stat_capable is False:
        trichotomy = "B — DESIGN CAPABLE, STATISTIC INCAPABLE"
    elif stat_capable is True:
        trichotomy = "C — BOTH CAPABLE"
    else:
        trichotomy = "? — NOT FULLY CHECKED"
    
    if n_conditional > 0:
        trichotomy += f" ({n_conditional} gates conditional on declared independence)"

    advisor = design_advisor(spec) if g2.get("pass_") == False else []

    return dict(
        gates=results, counts=counts, n_conditional=n_conditional,
        total_gates=len(results), all_verified_pass=all_verified_pass,
        trichotomy=trichotomy,
        design_floor_bits=g1["bits_optimistic"],
        stat_floor_bits=g2["bits"],
        headroom_bits=g1["bits_optimistic"] - g2["bits"],
        capacity=g6["capacity"],
        can_rank=g6["can_rank_n_claims"],
        sharing_verified=sharing_verified,
        alpha=alpha, q=q, k=n_units, N=N,
        randomization=randomization, sharing=sharing,
        advisor=advisor,
    )


def fmt_cert(cert):
    lines = []
    lines.append("=" * 80)
    lines.append("  UNIFIED p-VALUE CERTIFICATION  ·  v1.4  ·  7 gates  ·  3 dials")
    lines.append("=" * 80)
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"  Design:   k = {cert['k']} units, q = {f2s(cert['q'])}, "
                 f"alpha = {cert['alpha']}, N = {cert['N']} outcomes")
    lines.append(f"  Method:   randomization = {cert['randomization']},  "
                 f"sharing = {cert['sharing']},  "
                 f"independence verified = {cert['sharing_verified']}")
    
    if cert["n_conditional"] > 0:
        lines.append(f"  ⚠ WARNING: {cert['n_conditional']} gate(s) CONDITIONAL on "
                     f"DECLARED unit independence (not verified from data).")
        lines.append(f"    'The gates can verify what you declare; they cannot verify that")
        lines.append(f"     your declaration describes your data.' — agent-086B")
    
    lines.append(f"  Design max bits:  {cert['design_floor_bits']:.2f}")
    lines.append(f"  Stat resolution:  {cert['stat_floor_bits']:.2f}")
    lines.append(f"  Unused headroom:  {cert['headroom_bits']:.2f}")
    lines.append(f"  Capacity:         {cert['capacity']} rankable claims below alpha")
    lines.append(f"  Trichotomy:       {cert['trichotomy']}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("  GATES")

                    detail="Axis-0 failure: statistic is constant under null.")

                verdict=f"✓ PASS — statistic takes {null_support_size} distinct values under null",
                detail=f"null support size = {null_support_size}")

# G1
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def gate1_design_resolution(n_units, unit_group_order, alpha, sharing="declared_disjoint",
                           randomization="exact", n_shuffles=None,
                           sharing_verified=False):
    """G1: design resolution.
    
    v1.4 CORRECTION: sharing defaults to 'declared_disjoint' (NOT verified),
    which triggers CONDITIONAL status. User must explicitly set sharing_verified=True
    or sharing="complete" to get an unconditional result.
    """
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)
    
    if randomization == "monte_carlo" and n_shuffles is not None:
        N = n_shuffles + 1
        floor = F(1, N)
        note = f"monte carlo (B={n_shuffles}): N = B+1 = {N}"
        capable = floor <= alpha_f
        
        verdict = (f"✓ PASS — MC floor = 1/{N} <= alpha = {alpha}"
                   if capable else
                   f"✗ FAIL — MC FLOOR = 1/{N} > alpha = {alpha}")
        
        result = dict(pass_=capable, status="pass" if capable else "fail",
                      gate="G1 DESIGN RESOLUTION", verdict=verdict, detail=note,
                      floor_conservative=floor, floor_optimistic=floor,
                      N_outcomes=N, bits_conservative=bits(floor), bits_optimistic=bits(floor),
                      capable_under_all=capable, capable_under_some=capable,
                      randomization="monte_carlo")
        return result
    
    # exact
    is_disjoint = sharing in ("disjoint", "declared_disjoint")
    
    if is_disjoint:
        floor = F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        cons, opt = floor, floor
        if sharing == "declared_disjoint" and not sharing_verified:
            note = "DISJOINT DECLARED BUT NOT VERIFIED — CONDITIONAL"
        else:
            note = "verified disjoint units: design floor is exact"
    elif sharing == "complete":
        floor = F(1, unit_group_order)
        cons, opt = floor, F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        note = "complete sharing: conservative = 1/|G|, optimistic = 1/|G|^k"
    else:
        cons = F(1, unit_group_order)
        opt = F(1, unit_group_order ** n_units)
        floor = cons
        note = "mixed sharing: bracket between conservative and optimistic"

    N = unit_group_order ** n_units if is_disjoint else unit_group_order
    capable = floor <= alpha_f
    opt_capable = opt <= alpha_f

    if not opt_capable:
        verdict = "✗ FAIL — DESIGN INCAPABLE: even with full independence, floor > alpha"
        status = "fail"
    elif capable and sharing_verified:
        verdict = "✓ PASS — CAPABLE UNDER EVERY COUPLING: even conservative floor clears alpha"
        status = "pass"
    elif capable and not sharing_verified and is_disjoint:
        verdict = "· NOTE — capable if independence holds; CONDITIONAL on declared units being truly disjoint"
        status = "pass"  # still passes logically, but conditional
    else:
        verdict = "· NOTE — UNDECIDED FROM STRUCTURE: bracket spans alpha"
        status = "pass"

    result = dict(pass_=capable, status=status,
                  gate="G1 DESIGN RESOLUTION", verdict=verdict,
                  detail=f"design floor (conservative) = {f2s(floor)} ({bits(floor):.2f} bits); "
                         f"floor (optimistic) = {f2s(opt)} ({bits(opt):.2f} bits); alpha = {alpha}; {note}",
                  floor_conservative=cons, floor_optimistic=opt, N_outcomes=N,
                  bits_conservative=bits(cons), bits_optimistic=bits(opt),
                  capable_under_all=capable, capable_under_some=opt_capable,
                  randomization="exact", sharing=sharing, sharing_verified=sharing_verified)
    
    # CONDITIONAL if disjoint declared but not verified
    if is_disjoint and not sharing_verified and n_units > 1:
        result = conditional(result, "declared unit independence not verified from data")
    
    return result

def gate2_statistic_resolution(per_unit_q, n_units, alpha, sharing="declared_disjoint",
                                sharing_verified=False):
    q = frac(per_unit_q)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)
    is_disjoint = sharing in ("disjoint", "declared_disjoint")

    if is_disjoint:
        floor = q ** n_units
        if sharing == "declared_disjoint" and not sharing_verified:
            note = "DISJOINT DECLARED BUT NOT VERIFIED"
        else:
            note = "independent units: statistic floor = q^k"
    elif sharing == "complete":
        floor = q
        note = "complete sharing: floor = q"
    else:
        floor = q
        note = "mixed: conservative = q"

    capable = floor <= alpha_f

    verdict = (f"✓ PASS — statistic floor = {f2s(floor)} <= alpha = {alpha}"
               if capable else
               f"✗ FAIL — STATISTIC INCAPABLE: floor = {f2s(floor)} > alpha = {alpha}")

    result = dict(pass_=capable, status="pass" if capable else "fail",
                  gate="G2 STATISTIC RESOLUTION", verdict=verdict,
                  detail=f"per-unit q = {f2s(q)} ({bits(q):.2f} bits); "
                         f"statistic floor = {f2s(floor)} ({bits(floor):.2f} bits); {note}",
                  q=q, floor=floor, bits=bits(floor))
    
    if is_disjoint and not sharing_verified and n_units > 1:
        result = conditional(result, "declared unit independence not verified from data")
    
    return result

def gate3_saturation(observed_p, stat_floor, design_floor, alpha, randomization="exact",
                     n_shuffles=None):
    """G3: saturation / censorship.
    
    v1.4 CORRECTION: MC at floor = CONSERVATIVE VALID, not FAIL.
    `(X+1)/(B+1)` is exactly valid under exchangeability (agent-0220, agent-086B).
    Being at the floor means the true p could be smaller — the p-value is
    conservative, not wrong.
    """
    p = frac(observed_p)
    sf = frac(stat_floor)
    df = frac(design_floor)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)

    at_floor = (p == sf)

    if not at_floor:
        return dict(pass_=True, status="pass",
                    gate="G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP",
                    verdict="✓ PASS — p is NOT at the statistic floor; measurement carries information",
                    detail=f"observed p = {f2s(p)}, stat floor = {f2s(sf)} "
                           f"(gap factor = {float(sf/p):.2f}x)",
                    at_floor=False, status_sat="informative")

    # At the floor
    if randomization == "monte_carlo":
        # v1.4 CORRECTION: MC at floor is VALID (conservative), not FAIL
        return dict(pass_=True, status="pass",
                    gate="G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP",
                    verdict="· NOTE — CENSORED BY BUDGET: p = 1/(B+1), the MC floor. "
                            "Valid conservative p-value; true p could be smaller.",
                    detail=f"observed p = {f2s(p)} = MC floor (B={n_shuffles}); "
                           "valid per (X+1)/(B+1) rule (agent-0220 / agent-086B correction); "
                           "true p ≤ observed p",
                    at_floor=True, status_sat="censored_valid")
    
    # exact
    if sf > alpha_f:
        return dict(pass_=False, status="fail",
                    gate="G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP",
                    verdict="✗ FAIL — BROKEN INSTRUMENT: exact p equals statistic floor, "
                            "which exceeds alpha ('no test exists').",
                    detail=f"observed p = {f2s(p)} = statistic floor; "
                           f"design floor = {f2s(df)} ({bits(df):.2f} bits)",
                    at_floor=True, status_sat="broken_instrument")
    elif df > alpha_f:
        return dict(pass_=False, status="fail",
                    gate="G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP",
                    verdict="✗ FAIL — INCONSISTENT: stat floor below alpha but design floor above?",
                    detail="", at_floor=True, status_sat="inconsistent")
    else:
        return dict(pass_=True, status="pass",
                    gate="G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP",
                    verdict="· NOTE — SATURATED GOOD: p equals statistic floor, "
                            "which is well below alpha. MAXIMAL EVIDENCE, not a defect.",
                    detail=f"observed p = {f2s(p)} = statistic floor; "
                           f"design floor = {f2s(df)} ({bits(df):.2f} bits); "
                           f"headroom = {bits(df) - bits(sf):.2f} bits",
                    at_floor=True, status_sat="maximal_evidence")

def gate4_exactness(observed_p, per_unit_q=None, n_units=None, stat_floor=None,
                    null_support_size=None, randomization="exact", n_shuffles=None):
    p = frac(observed_p)
    details, issues = [], []

    if stat_floor is not None and p < frac(stat_floor):
        issues.append(f"p = {f2s(p)} < statistic floor = {f2s(stat_floor)}: UNREACHABLE")

    if randomization == "exact" and per_unit_q is not None and n_units is not None:
        expected_saturated = frac(per_unit_q) ** n_units
        if p == expected_saturated:
            details.append(f"matches saturated prediction q^k = {f2s(expected_saturated)}")
    
    if randomization == "monte_carlo" and n_shuffles is not None:
        B = n_shuffles
        k = round(float(p) * (B + 1))
        if abs(float(p) - k / (B + 1)) > 1e-9:
            issues.append(f"p = {f2s(p)} not on MC lattice k/(B+1) for B={B}")
        else:
            details.append(f"on MC lattice: {k}/{B+1}")

    if issues:
        return dict(pass_=False, status="fail", gate="G4 EXACTNESS",
                    verdict="✗ FAIL — p-value inconsistent with declared randomization",
                    detail="; ".join(issues) + "; " + "; ".join(details))

    return dict(pass_=True, status="pass", gate="G4 EXACTNESS",
                verdict="✓ PASS — p-value consistent with declared randomization",
                detail=("; ".join(details) if details else "on the lattice"))

# G5

def gate5_unit_budget(per_unit_q, alpha, current_k=None):
    q = frac(per_unit_q)
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)

    if not (0 < q < 1):
        return dict(pass_=False, status="fail", gate="G5 UNIT BUDGET",
                    verdict="✗ FAIL — q must be in (0,1)", detail=f"q = {f2s(q)}")

    k_needed = 1
    while q ** k_needed > alpha_f:
        k_needed += 1
        if k_needed > 10000:
            return dict(pass_=False, status="fail", gate="G5 UNIT BUDGET",
                        verdict="✗ FAIL — q too close to 1, k_needed > 10000", detail="")

    p_at_needed = q ** k_needed

    result = dict(pass_=True, status="pass", gate="G5 UNIT BUDGET",
                  verdict=f"k_needed = {k_needed} disjoint units at q = {f2s(q)} -> p = {f2s(p_at_needed)}",
                  detail=f"bits per unit = {bits(q):.2f}; bits required = {bits(alpha_f):.2f}; "
                         f"k_needed = ceil({bits(alpha_f):.2f} / {bits(q):.2f}) = {k_needed}",
                  k_needed=k_needed, p_at_needed=p_at_needed, q=q, alpha=alpha_f)

    if current_k is not None:
        deficit = max(0, k_needed - current_k)
        result["current_k"] = current_k
        result["deficit_units"] = deficit
        result["current_p_if_perfect"] = q ** current_k
        result["verdict"] += (f"; current k = {current_k}, deficit = {deficit} unit(s)"
                              if deficit > 0 else
                              f"; current k = {current_k}, surplus = {current_k - k_needed} unit(s)")
    
    return result

def gate6_discrimination(N_outcomes, alpha, n_competing_claims=2,
                         sharing_verified=False, n_units=1, sharing="declared_disjoint"):
    alpha_f = frac(alpha)
    N = N_outcomes
    capacity = int(alpha_f * N)
    can_rank = capacity >= n_competing_claims

    if capacity == 0:
        verdict = "✗ FAIL — CAPACITY = 0: no claim can be supported at this alpha"
        status = "fail"
        pass_ = False
    elif capacity == 1:
        verdict = "· NOTE — CAPACITY = 1: one claim can pass, but NO TWO can be RANKED. At a floor, all claims are equal."
        status = "pass"
        pass_ = True
    else:
        verdict = f"✓ PASS — CAPACITY = {capacity}: up to {capacity} claims can be ranked below alpha"
        status = "pass"
        pass_ = True

    result = dict(pass_=pass_, status=status, gate="G6 DISCRIMINATION CAPACITY",
                  verdict=verdict,
                  detail=f"N = {N} outcomes, alpha = {alpha}; "
                         f"capacity = floor(alpha * N) = {capacity}; "
                         f"can rank {n_competing_claims} claims: {can_rank}",
                  capacity=capacity, N=N, can_rank_n_claims=can_rank,
                  max_separation_factor=capacity)
    
    is_disjoint = sharing in ("disjoint", "declared_disjoint")
    if is_disjoint and not sharing_verified and n_units > 1:
        result = conditional(result, "declared unit independence not verified from data")
    
    return result

# q-ladder
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

PERMS = list(permutations((0, 1, 2, 3)))


def _level_set_size(stat, means):
    obs = stat(tuple(means))
    return sum(1 for g in PERMS if stat(tuple(means[g[i]] for i in range(4))) == obs)


def q_ladder_s4(means=(1.0, 2.0, 3.0, 4.0)):
    stats = [
        ("sign of a contrast",   lambda m: (m[0]+m[1]) - (m[2]+m[3]) < 0),
        ("which label is max",   lambda m: max(range(4), key=lambda i: m[i])),
        ("top-2 as SET (unord)", lambda m: frozenset(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i])[:2])),
        ("top-2 ORDERED",        lambda m: tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i])[:2])),
        ("FULL ordering",        lambda m: tuple(sorted(range(4), key=lambda i: -m[i]))),
    ]
    rows = []
    for name, f in stats:
        ls = _level_set_size(f, means)
        q = F(ls, 24)
        rows.append(dict(statistic=name, level_set_size=ls, q=q, q_float=float(q),
                         bits_per_unit=bits(q)))
    return rows

# design advisor
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def design_advisor(spec, cert_result):
    q = frac(spec.get("per_unit_q", spec.get("statistic_level_set", 8) / spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)))
    k = spec.get("n_units", 1)
    alpha = frac(spec.get("alpha", 0.05))
    group_order = spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)

    suggestions = []
    ladder = q_ladder_s4() if group_order == 24 else []
    
    for rung in ladder:
        if rung["q"] < q:
            new_p = rung["q"] ** k
            works = new_p <= alpha
            suggestions.append(dict(
                route="sharpen_statistic",
                description=f"Use '{rung['statistic']}' statistic (q = {f2s(rung['q'])}, vs current {f2s(q)})",
                new_k=k, new_q=rung["q"], new_p=new_p, works_at_alpha=works,
                cost="theoretical: stronger prediction must be pre-registered"))

    budget = gate5_unit_budget(q, alpha, current_k=k)
    if budget.get("deficit_units", 0) > 0:
        suggestions.append(dict(
            route="add_disjoint_units",
            description=f"Add {budget['deficit_units']} more disjoint unit(s) (k = {k} -> {budget['k_needed']})",
            new_k=budget["k_needed"], new_q=q, new_p=budget["p_at_needed"],
            works_at_alpha=True,
            cost="computational: more data — BUT independence MUST be verified, not just declared"))

    for rung in ladder:
        if rung["q"] < q:
            b = gate5_unit_budget(rung["q"], alpha, current_k=k)
            deficit = b.get("deficit_units", 0)
            if deficit > 0 and deficit < budget.get("deficit_units", 99):
                suggestions.append(dict(
                    route="both",
                    description=f"'{rung['statistic']}' statistic + {deficit} more unit(s) (k = {k} -> {b['k_needed']})",
                    new_k=b["k_needed"], new_q=rung["q"], new_p=b["p_at_needed"],
                    works_at_alpha=True,
                    cost=f"mixed: sharper claim + {deficit} more blocks"))

    def score(s): return (0 if s["works_at_alpha"] else 1, float(s["new_p"]))
    suggestions.sort(key=score)
    return suggestions

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def certify(spec):
    results = []

    n_units = spec.get("n_units", 1)
    unit_order = spec.get("unit_group_order", 24)
    alpha = spec.get("alpha", 0.05)
    
    # v1.4: default sharing is "declared_disjoint" — user says they're disjoint
    # but hasn't verified it from data. This triggers CONDITIONAL status.
    # User must explicitly set sharing_verified=True for unconditional results.
    sharing = spec.get("sharing_graph", "declared_disjoint")
    sharing_verified = spec.get("sharing_verified", False)
    
    randomization = spec.get("randomization", "exact")
    n_shuffles = spec.get("n_shuffles", None)

    if "per_unit_q" in spec:
        q = frac(spec["per_unit_q"])
    elif "statistic_level_set" in spec:
        q = F(spec["statistic_level_set"], unit_order)
    else:
        q = F(1, 3)

    null_support = spec.get("null_support_size", None)
    observed_p = spec.get("observed_p", None)
    n_competing = spec.get("n_competing_claims", 2)

    # G0
    g0 = gate0_null_validity(null_support)
    results.append(g0)

    # G1
    g1 = gate1_design_resolution(n_units, unit_order, alpha, sharing,
                                  randomization, n_shuffles, sharing_verified)
    results.append(g1)

    # G2
    g2 = gate2_statistic_resolution(q, n_units, alpha, sharing, sharing_verified)
    results.append(g2)

    # G3
    if observed_p is not None:
        stat_floor = g2["floor"]
        design_floor = g1["floor_conservative"]
        g3 = gate3_saturation(observed_p, stat_floor, design_floor, alpha,
                               randomization, n_shuffles)
        results.append(g3)
    else:
        results.append(not_checked("G3 SATURATION/CENSORSHIP", "no observed p-value provided"))

    # G4
    if observed_p is not None:
        g4 = gate4_exactness(observed_p, per_unit_q=q, n_units=n_units,
                             stat_floor=g2["floor"], null_support_size=null_support,
                             randomization=randomization, n_shuffles=n_shuffles)
        results.append(g4)
    else:
        results.append(not_checked("G4 EXACTNESS", "no observed p-value provided"))

    # G5
    g5 = gate5_unit_budget(q, alpha, current_k=n_units)
    results.append(g5)

    # G6
    N = g1["N_outcomes"]
    g6 = gate6_discrimination(N, alpha, n_competing_claims=n_competing,
                               sharing_verified=sharing_verified, n_units=n_units,
                               sharing=sharing)
    results.append(g6)

    # Summary
    passed = [r for r in results if r.get("status") == "pass"]
    failed = [r for r in results if r.get("status") == "fail"]
    conditional = [r for r in results if r.get("status") == "conditional"]
    not_checked_list = [r for r in results if r.get("status") == "not_checked"]
    
    all_verified_pass = len(failed) == 0

    # Trichotomy
    design_capable = g1["capable_under_some"]
    stat_capable = g2.get("pass_") if g2.get("pass_") is not None else None

    if not design_capable:
        trichotomy = "A — DESIGN INCAPABLE"
    elif stat_capable is False:
        trichotomy = "B — DESIGN CAPABLE, STATISTIC INCAPABLE"
    elif stat_capable is True:
        trichotomy = "C — BOTH CAPABLE"
    else:
        trichotomy = "? — NOT FULLY CHECKED"
    
    if n_units > 1 and not sharing_verified and sharing != "complete":
        trichotomy += " (conditional on declared independence)"

    advisor = design_advisor(spec, results) if g2.get("pass_") == False else []

    return dict(
        gates=results,
        n_pass=len(passed), n_fail=len(failed),
        n_conditional=len(conditional), n_not_checked=len(not_checked_list),
        total_gates=len(results),
        all_verified_pass=all_verified_pass,
        trichotomy=trichotomy,
        design_floor_bits=g1["bits_optimistic"],
        stat_floor_bits=g2["bits"],
        headroom_bits=g1["bits_optimistic"] - g2["bits"],
        capacity=g6["capacity"],
        can_rank=g6["can_rank_n_claims"],
        sharing_verified=sharing_verified,
        sharing=sharing,
        alpha=alpha, q=q, k=n_units, N=N,
        randomization=randomization,
        advisor=advisor,
    )


def fmt_cert(cert):
    lines = []
    lines.append("=" * 78)
    lines.append("  UNIFIED p-VALUE CERTIFICATION  ·  7 gates  ·  1 verdict  ·  v1.4")
    lines.append("=" * 78)
    lines.append("")
    lines.append(f"  Design: k = {cert['k']} units, q = {f2s(cert['q'])}, "
                 f"alpha = {cert['alpha']}, N = {cert['N']} outcomes")
    lines.append(f"  Randomization: {cert['randomization']}  ·  Sharing: {cert['sharing']}")
    
    if cert["n_conditional"] > 0:
        lines.append(f"  ⚠  {cert['n_conditional']} gate(s) CONDITIONAL on declared "
                     f"independence (not verified from data)")
    
    lines.append(f"  Design resolution (max): {cert['design_floor_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Statistic resolution:    {cert['stat_floor_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Unused headroom:         {cert['headroom_bits']:.2f} bits")
    lines.append(f"  Discrimination capacity: {cert['capacity']}")
    lines.append(f"  Trichotomy:  {cert['trichotomy']}")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("  GATES")
    lines.append("  " + "-" * 74)
    for g in cert["gates"]:
        lines.append(f"  {g['verdict']}")
        if g.get("detail"):
            lines.append(f"     {g['detail']}")
        lines.append("")

    if cert["advisor"]:
        lines.append("  DESIGN ADVISOR — suggested routes to significance")
        lines.append("  " + "-" * 74)
        for i, s in enumerate(cert["advisor"], 1):
            mark = "✓" if s["works_at_alpha"] else "·"
            lines.append(f"  {mark}  {i}. [{s['route']}] {s['description']}")
            lines.append(f"      new p = {f2s(s['new_p'])}  (k={s['new_k']}, q={f2s(s['new_q'])})")
            lines.append(f"      cost: {s['cost']}")
            lines.append("")

    lines.append(f"  Summary: {cert['n_pass']} pass, {cert['n_fail']} fail, "
                 f"{cert['n_conditional']} conditional, {cert['n_not_checked']} not checked")
    lines.append("")
    lines.append("  v1.4: MC at floor = valid conservative p-value (agent-0220 / agent-086B)")
    lines.append("        k must be verified from data, not just declared (agent-0230 / agent-096)")
    lines.append("=" * 78)
    return "\n".join(lines)
